data.name: INFOCUS
data.detailed_description:
Do you dream of running your own film studio? The Producer puts you in the driver's seat from start to finish.

From selecting the script to the theatrical release—including casting, filming, editing, and marketing campaigns—every decision counts. Manage your finances, recruit top talent, negotiate with stars, and face off against rival studios waiting for you to slip up so they can steal the spotlight.

Inspired by the depth of classic management simulation games, *The Producer* features a rich, intuitive interface designed for strategy enthusiasts who love diving into the details of every system.

🎬 Produce films, from the pitch to the closing credits

Choose your genres, assemble your team (directors, screenwriters, actors, crew), manage your production budget, and overcome on-set mishaps: budget overruns, diva behavior, script leaks. Every film is the result of hundreds of small decisions.

💰 Manage a real studio, not just a film catalog

Cash flow, loans, salaries, employee satisfaction, and investments in infrastructure and technology: your studio is a full-fledged business with its own risks and opportunities.

📣 Master marketing and distribution

Select your promotional campaigns, release dates, and distribution strategies (theaters, streaming, festivals). A great film with poor distribution can go unnoticed, while an average film marketed well can be a massive hit.

🏆 Aim for acclaim and awards

Submit your films to major festivals, vie for prestigious awards, and build a reputation that opens doors to cinema's biggest stars.

🌍 Compete in a dynamic market against real rivals

Rival studios—each with its own identity and strategy—operate alongside you. Market trends shift, audiences are demanding, and nothing is ever guaranteed. 📈 Build a long-term empire

Create franchises, churn out sequels, navigate the technological evolution of cinema over the decades, and turn your studio into an industry benchmark—or a formidable financial empire.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains shooting and killing events of other players as it involves gunfights in order to progress in the game.
